definitions.explanation: Counting down seconds before an event, such as a rocket launch or New Year's. Also used in shogi/go for time pressure at the end of a game.

examples.japanese: {秒読|びょうよ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ→打ち上げ：09795_uchiage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秒読|びょうよ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The launch has entered the countdown phase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧あと⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧、⟦いよいよ→いよいよ：06353_iyoiyo⟧{秒読|びょうよ}みだ。
examples.english: Three days until the opening — the countdown is on.

notes:
Counting down seconds before an event. Used both literally (rocket launches, New Year's) and figuratively (any situation approaching a deadline).

FORMS:
⟦{秒|びょう}→秒：00921_byou⟧ (second) + ⟦{読|よ}み→読み：00425_yomi⟧ (reading/counting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秒読|びょうよ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the countdown phase
- {秒読|びょうよ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: the countdown begins
- {秒読|びょうよ}み⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧: countdown stage

BOARD GAMES:
In ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ and ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧, {秒読|びょうよ}み refers to the time-pressure phase where a player must move within a set number of seconds. The timekeeper counts aloud.

USAGE:
Often used metaphorically: ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秒読|びょうよ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (the store has entered the countdown to closing).
